regions.today: Today will bring scattered showers and some sunny intervals, but the showers will become isolated later in the day. Highest temperatures of 16 to 19 degrees with a moderate westerly breeze.
regions.tonight: After a dry start with some clear spells, it will become cloudy and wet overnight as rain moves in from the southwest. Lowest temperatures of 9 to 12 degrees with a moderate to fresh south to southwest breeze.
regions.tomorrow: Rain will clear away to the northeast tomorrow morning and will be followed by scattered showers for the rest of the day. Some of the showers may be heavy and thundery. Highest temperatures of 14 to 18 degrees with a moderate to fresh south to southwest breeze.
